name: x2
scope: moomoo SG (Moomoo Financial Singapore), US stocks/ETFs, >=1 share orders, eligible-client schedule, SG tax resident
turnover_definition: one_way_daily_turnover tau = (buy_value + sell_value) / (2 * equity), per trading day
annual_cost_identity: annual_cost_fraction = days_per_year * tau * roundtrip_cost_bps / 1e4  (whole-ticket round trips)
cohort_identity: gross_exposure_over_equity = holding_days * tau  (H-day cohorts, equal tickets)
unverified: actual $0-commission eligibility of the future account (T&C page link resolved to a promotions index, not the T&C)
per-invoice rounding of each fee line
whether GST is charged on pass-through regulatory fees (two notes on F1 disagree; x1 takes the wider reading)
FY2027 Section 31 rate (F5: changes 60 days after FY2027 appropriation; none published as of fetch)
historical TAF/SEC rates before 2026 (fold back-test applies 2026 schedule to all years; assumption, not history)
definition: x2 = 2 * (x1 explicit fees incl. GST + x1 spread + x1 slippage) per round trip; gate floor also doubled (40 bps RT). Same convention as EVO-879 cost_arithmetic.py (stress_gate_breakeven_bps = 2 * gate_breakeven_bps; return_scenarios mult 2).
